shop=# EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
shop-# SELECT c.name, count(*) AS orders, sum(o.total) AS spent
shop-# FROM customers c
shop-# JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
shop-# WHERE o.created_at >= date '2026-06-01'
shop-#   AND c.country = 'IN'
shop-# GROUP BY c.name
shop-# ORDER BY spent DESC
shop-# LIMIT 10;
